mechanism.claim: During elevated completed realized variation, a four-hour close newly escaping the official Acceleration Bands(10,4,SMA) envelope identifies directional price acceleration beyond a range-expanded high/low boundary. Follow the outward break for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict close cross above the completed upper band; short on a strict close cross below the completed lower band
mechanism.why_distinct: Acceleration Bands first expands every high and low by its own contemporaneous range-to-midprice coefficient and then averages those transformed boundaries. This is neither close dispersion (Bollinger), ATR around a center (Keltner), raw extrema (Donchian), nor OLS residual dispersion (Regression Channel). No fitted outcome, volume, flow, OI, funding, reused event set, or promoted control is used.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the transformed envelope demands acceleration beyond recent range geometry while trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour transformed-range envelope crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.coefficient: 4*(high-low)/(high+low), denominator strict positive for valid BTC prices
features.upper_band: SMA(10) of high*(1+coefficient), including current completed bar
features.lower_band: SMA(10) of low*(1-coefficient), including current completed bar
features.event: current close>current upper and previous close<=previous upper gives long; current close<current lower and previous close>=previous lower gives short; exactly one side
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid four-hour decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: bar aggregation, all three SMA windows, crossing state, and variation history reset after any invalid completed source bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official documented AccelerationBands(10,4,SMA) outward crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, width, average type, transformation, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Price Headley Acceleration Bands; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: official documentation example period=10,width=4,Simple; coefficient=4*(high-low)/(high+low) with SafeDivision; raw upper=high*(1+coefficient), raw lower=low*(1-coefficient), raw middle=close; each output is its 10-period SMA; warmup 10
external_basis.selection_use: official example period, default width, SMA type, formulas, readiness, and outward crossing only; no incidence or outcomes
